purpose: Specify negative test cases for batch-assurance settlement (mutual exclusivity, operator signing, amount conservation, deadline enforcement)

testCases.name: Attempt Both Release and Refund in Same Settlement
testCases.description: Campaign attempts to settle with both RELEASE and REFUND outcomes in same transaction
testCases.precondition: Batch-assurance covenant with pledge pool and operator signature requirement
testCases.action: Build transaction with both release output (to beneficiary) and refund output (to pledgers)
testCases.expectedBehavior: rejected by covenant (mutual exclusivity enforced in script logic)
testCases.why: Covenant enforces exactly one outcome per campaign; prevents double-spending of same pledge pool

testCases.name: Settlement with Wrong Operator Key
testCases.description: Attempt batch settlement using signature from non-operator key
testCases.precondition: Covenant specifies operator=OP_KEY; attacker uses different key
testCases.action: Call settlement path with signature from attacker_key (not OP_KEY)
testCases.expectedBehavior: rejected by covenant (operator signature verification fails)
testCases.why: Only registered operator can trigger settlement; prevents unauthorized person from settling campaign

testCases.name: Settlement Without Operator Signature
testCases.description: Attempt settlement without providing required operator signature in witness
testCases.action: Build transaction with empty witness data (no operator signature)
testCases.why: Covenant requires operator sign-off; settlement without signature is unauthorized

testCases.name: Release Amount Greater Than Pledge Pool
testCases.description: Attempt to release more funds to beneficiary than total pledges
testCases.precondition: Pledge pool = 100 TKAS; attempt release = 101 TKAS
testCases.action: Build release transaction with output > total input
testCases.why: Cannot release more than was pledged; covenant enforces input/output balance

testCases.name: Refund Amount Less Than Pledge Pool
testCases.description: Refund to pledgers is less than original pledge amount (funds lost/stolen)
testCases.action: Build refund transaction with output < total input
testCases.why: All pledges must be returned in refund; covenant prevents fund loss

testCases.name: Release to Wrong Beneficiary
testCases.description: Attempt to release campaign funds to address other than registered beneficiary
testCases.action: Call release with output going to attacker_address instead of BENEFICIARY_ADDRESS
testCases.why: Covenant locks release recipient to beneficiary; prevents operator from stealing funds

testCases.name: Settle Campaign After Deadline Passed
testCases.description: Attempt to settle a campaign whose deadline has already passed
testCases.precondition: Campaign deadline = 2026-05-10 12:00 UTC; current time = 2026-05-10 13:00 UTC
testCases.action: Call settlement path after deadline; covenant checks timestamp in script
testCases.why: Campaigns can only settle within deadline window; prevents late settlements

testCases.name: Settle Campaign Before Pledge Deadline
testCases.description: Attempt to settle campaign while pledges are still being collected
testCases.action: Call settlement before campaign pledge period closes
testCases.expectedBehavior: rejected by covenant (settlement forbidden before pledge deadline)
testCases.why: Campaign must collect all pledges before settlement; prevents early settlement with incomplete pledges

testCases.name: Refund to Only Some Pledgers
testCases.description: Refund transaction includes outputs for pledgers A, B, C but not D, E
testCases.precondition: Campaign has 5 pledgers; only 3 receive refund
testCases.action: Build refund with missing pledger outputs (funds stuck in covenant)
testCases.expectedBehavior: rejected by covenant (mutual exclusivity + amount mismatch checks)
testCases.why: All pledges must be returned together; prevents selective refund (fund loss)

testCases.name: Settle Campaign with Zero Pledges
testCases.description: Attempt to settle campaign that has no pledges (invalid state)
testCases.precondition: Campaign created but no pledges collected
testCases.action: Call settlement on empty campaign; attempt release with zero input
testCases.why: Cannot settle campaign with no pledges; prevents spurious settlement

testCases.name: Replay Same Settlement (Spend Same UTXO Twice)
testCases.description: After campaign settles with release, attacker replays same transaction to spend already-spent UTXO
testCases.precondition: Campaign UTXO already spent in release settlement
testCases.expectedBehavior: rejected by mempool (input already spent) or by consensus (orphan UTXO)
testCases.why: UTXO consumed in settlement; cannot replay

testCases.name: Settlement with Zero Fee (Dust Output)
testCases.description: Settle with such high fee that output becomes less than dust threshold
testCases.precondition: Pledge pool = 100 satoshi; fee = 100 satoshi → output = 0
testCases.action: Build settlement with excessive fee, creating zero/dust output
testCases.expectedBehavior: rejected by covenant or validator (zero output disallowed)
testCases.why: Cannot create zero-value outputs; prevents fund destruction

executionStrategy.successCriteria: All 12 cases correctly rejected; legitimate settlement paths (release, refund) still work

implementationNotes: Batch-assurance negative tests focus on operator authorization, mutual-exclusive outcomes, and amount conservation. Critical issues include wrong operator signature and amount mismatches. Deadline enforcement and partial refunds are secondary but important for campaign correctness.
